subject.title: normalizeGitHubActor: not idempotent — strips only one trailing [bot]

question: Should mutation authorization treat repeated trailing `[bot]` suffixes as the same bot identity and strip them to a fixed point, or reject/retain malformed repeated suffixes instead?
rationale: The code change is mechanically small, but this helper participates in actor normalization near mutation authorization; maintainer intent is needed to avoid silently broadening identity equivalence.

options.title: Normalize to a fixed point
options.body: Remove all consecutive trailing `[bot]` suffixes in the centralized actor helper and add authorization-focused regression coverage for repeated and ordinary bot identities.

options.title: Reject repeated suffixes
options.body: Preserve the current canonical single suffix but make callers fail closed when repeated suffixes are encountered, if malformed identities must never map to a trusted actor.

recommendation.title: Normalize to a fixed point
recommendation.body: Remove all consecutive trailing `[bot]` suffixes in the centralized actor helper and add authorization-focused regression coverage for repeated and ordinary bot identities.
